name: DBX Mail
description: Local-first mail workbench: multiple IMAP accounts, cached conversations, a rich composer, offline outbox and attachments kept on disk.

contributions.label: 邮件
contributions.description: 本地优先的多账户邮件工作台：会话列表、阅读器、富文本撰写与离线发件箱。
Mail tools over the plugin's own accounts: list, read, flag, move and send messages.

contributions.label: Mail account
contributions.description: Mail account managed from the DBX connection manager: IMAP/SMTP servers, or Microsoft 365 / Outlook.com (Graph) with browser sign-in inside the plugin, or app-only access (client credentials).

fields.label: Email address
fields.description: Unique identifier of this account inside the plugin.

fields.label: Azure client ID
fields.description: Application (client) ID from the Azure Portal app registration. The browser authorization happens inside the plugin after connecting.

fields.label: Azure tenant
fields.description: "common" for personal or multi-tenant apps, or your organization tenant ID / domain.

fields.label: Authorization
fields.description: Browser sign-in authorizes interactively inside the plugin workbench. App-only uses client credentials to access the mailbox in the background without any browser interaction.

fields.label: Azure client secret
fields.description: Client secret from the Azure Portal app registration (app-only mode). Kept in the host secret store; the plugin holds it in memory only while connected.

fields.label: Mailbox user ID
fields.description: Object ID or UPN of the mailbox this app permission grants access to (app-only mode). Leave empty to use the email address above.

fields.label: Password
fields.description: Kept in the host secret store; the plugin holds it in memory only while connected.
